verses.en: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
verses.pt: E no sétimo mês, ao primeiro do mês tereis santa convocação: nenhuma obra servil fareis; vos será dia de soar as trombetas.
verses.en_web: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.
verses.en_bbe: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, let there be a holy meeting; on it you may do no field-work; let the day be marked by the blowing of horns;

verses.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.pt: E oferecereis holocausto por cheiro suave ao SENHOR, um bezerro das vacas, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And give to the Lord a burned offering for a sweet smell; one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark on them:

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
verses.pt: E a oferta de cereais deles, de boa farinha amassada com azeite, três décimos de efa com cada bezerro, dois décimos com cada carneiro,
verses.en_web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,

verses.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.pt: e com cada um dos sete cordeiros, uma décimo;
verses.en_web: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.en_bbe: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação, para reconciliar-vos:
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering, to take away your sin:

verses.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.pt: Além do holocausto do mês, e sua oferta de cereais, e o holocausto contínuo e sua oferta de cereais, e suas libações, conforme sua lei, por oferta queimada ao SENHOR em cheiro suave.
verses.en_web: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: In addition to the burned offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the regular burned offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, as they are ordered, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.

verses.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
verses.pt: E no dez deste mês sétimo tereis santa convocação, e afligireis vossas almas: nenhuma obra fareis:
verses.en_web: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;
verses.en_bbe: And on the tenth day of this seventh month there will be a holy meeting; keep yourselves from pleasure, and do no sort of work;

verses.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.pt: E oferecereis em holocausto ao SENHOR por cheiro suave, um bezerro das vacas, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de ano; sem defeito os tomareis:
verses.en_web: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; all without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And give to the Lord a burned offering for a sweet smell; one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year: only those without any mark on them may be used:

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
verses.pt: E suas ofertas de cereais, boa farinha amassada com azeite, três décimos de efa com cada bezerro, dois décimos com cada carneiro,
verses.en_web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,

verses.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.pt: e com cada um dos sete cordeiros, um décimo;
verses.en_web: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs:
verses.en_bbe: A separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;

verses.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.pt: um bode macho por expiação; além da oferta das expiações pelo pecado, e do holocausto contínuo, e de suas ofertas de cereais, e de suas libações.
verses.en_web: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.en_bbe: One he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the offering for taking away your sin, and the regular burned offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
verses.pt: Também aos quinze dias do mês sétimo tereis santa convocação; nenhuma obra servil fareis, e celebrareis solenidade ao SENHOR por sete dias;
verses.en_web: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days.
verses.en_bbe: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month let there be a holy meeting; do no field-work, and keep a feast to the Lord for seven days;

verses.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
verses.pt: E oferecereis em holocausto, em oferta queimada ao SENHOR em cheiro suave, treze bezerros das vacas, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de um ano; devem ser sem defeito;
verses.en_web: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; all without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And give a burned offering, an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, thirteen oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, all without any mark on them;

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
verses.pt: E as ofertas de cereais deles, de boa farinha amassada com azeite, três décimos de efa com cada um dos treze bezerros, dois décimos com cada um dos dois carneiros,
verses.en_web: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every one of the thirteen oxen, two tenth parts for every male sheep,

verses.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
verses.pt: e com cada um dos catorze cordeiros, um décimo;
verses.en_web: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;
verses.en_bbe: And a separate tenth part for every one of the fourteen lambs;

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: e um bode macho por expiação; além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.pt: E no segundo dia, doze bezerros das vacas, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: On the second day of the feast give an offering of twelve oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark on them;

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen and the sheep and the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, e sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.en: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.pt: E no dia terceiro, onze bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And on the third day eleven oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark;

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering and drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, e sua oferta de alimentos e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.pt: E no quarto dia, dez bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And on the fourth day ten oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

verses.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: Suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered.

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.pt: E no quinto dia, nove bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And on the fifth day nine oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.pt: E no sexto dia, oito bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And on the sixth day eight oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, sua oferta de cereais e suas libações.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, its meal offering, and its drink offerings.

verses.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.pt: E no sétimo dia, sete bezerros, dois carneiros, catorze cordeiros de ano sem defeito;
verses.en_web: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And on the seventh day seven oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: E suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com os bezerros, com os carneiros, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;
verses.en_bbe: And their meal offering and their drink offerings for the oxen, for the male sheep, and for the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
verses.pt: No oitavo dia tereis solenidade; nenhuma obra servil fareis;
verses.en_web: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no regular work;
verses.en_bbe: On the eighth day let there be a holy meeting: you may do no field-work;

verses.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.pt: E oferecereis em holocausto, em oferta de queima de cheiro suave ao SENHOR, um novilho, um carneiro, sete cordeiros de um ano, sem defeito;
verses.en_web: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;
verses.en_bbe: And give a burned offering, an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord: one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:

verses.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.pt: Suas ofertas de cereais e suas libações com o novilho, com o carneiro, e com os cordeiros, segundo o número deles, conforme a lei;
verses.en_web: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:
verses.en_bbe: With the meal offering and the drink offerings for the ox, the male sheep, and the lambs, in relation to their number, as it is ordered:

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.pt: E um bode macho por expiação: além do holocausto contínuo, com sua oferta de cereais e sua libação.
verses.en_web: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.
verses.en_bbe: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

verses.en: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.pt: Estas coisas oferecereis ao SENHOR em vossas solenidades, além de vossos votos, e de vossas ofertas livres, para vossos holocaustos, e para vossas ofertas de cereais, e para vossas libações e para vossas ofertas pacíficas.
verses.en_web: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”
verses.en_bbe: These are the offerings which you are to give to the Lord at your regular feasts, in addition to the offerings for an oath, and the free offerings you give, for your burned offerings and your drink offerings and your peace-offerings.

verses.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: E Moisés disse aos filhos de Israel, conforme tudo o que o SENHOR lhe havia mandado.
verses.en_web: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses gave the children of Israel all these directions as the Lord had given him orders.
